notes.subject: תושיה
notes.rationale: Hlaka ye e kaya tshepo/thaka — ditlhophwa tše dingwe di re 'yo a nago bohlale' (KJV) goba 'go tšaba leina la gago ke bohlale' (JPS)

notes.subject: מטה
notes.rationale: E ka ra šaka ya go hlwaya goba setšhaba (šaka sa [borwa]); Sepedi 'kgobokano ya batho' e boloka mo go se kgalwe

notes.subject: to the city
notes.rationale: Poo e bitša setšhaba: 'theelang' — moletlo wa go theetša

notes.subject: to the city
notes.rationale: Yahwe o bolela le setšhaba se legolo ka bowe

translation: Lentšu la Yahwe le bitša setšhaba se legolo, gomme yo a nago tshepo o tla tšaba leina la gago; theelang kgobokano ya batho, gomme ke mang yo a e rulagantšego?
